episodes.synopsis: Shido meets a pretty trickster that loves to get compliments. He also runs amok at the school doing one naughty thing after another. Or does he?
episodes.title: The Seventh Spirit

episodes.synopsis: While the witch impersonates one of his friends, Shido is forced into a game where he must identify Natsumi before it's too late and they all disappear.
episodes.title: Can You Find Me?

episodes.synopsis: Shido is losing his head and losing friends faster with each passing day of Natsumi's game. But when it's all over, he may have a little problem on his hands.
episodes.title: You're Natsumi

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi uses her powers to turn the girls into children. But their plan to convince Natsumi that her true form is cute turns out to be no child's play at all.
episodes.title: Transformation

episodes.synopsis: The Humpty Dumpty satellite has a great fall towards Tengu City. Will Natsumi realize her own self-worth before the city is reduced to rubble?
episodes.title: Despair Comes Crashing Down

episodes.synopsis: Origami makes an unexpected decision that shakes things up. While Shido runs off to investigate, a spatial quake alarm lands the others in a special kind of trouble.
episodes.title: Crossroads

episodes.synopsis: As Fraxinus defends against a fierce opponent, Origami stops at nothing to fulfill her wish and makes the ultimate sacrifice. Will she regret the cost to gain what she wanted?
episodes.title: The Power Given

episodes.synopsis: Origami is on a mission to avenge her parents, but when she finally discovers the truth, it turns out to be much harsher than she bargained for.
episodes.title: Demon King of Descending Darkness

episodes.synopsis: On a mission to avert disaster, Shido attempts to rewrite history. Can he stop Origami's crazed rampage or are her parents doomed to die?
episodes.title: Tengu City, Five Years Ago

episodes.synopsis: Shido wakes up and finds that the world around him is different. His attempt to thwart disaster may have succeeded, but for how long will it last?
episodes.title: Another World, Another Girl

episodes.synopsis: Shido takes Origami on a date but she's not acting like herself. After all hell breaks loose, the fate of the world depends on whether he can reach out to her heart or not.
episodes.title: Angel of the Starry Night

episodes.synopsis: All the sealed Spirit power is making Shido go wild, but the only cure is to kiss him again. Can all the girls entice Shido to fall for them before it's too late?
episodes.title: Make Shido Itsuka Swoon
